prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet adoption certificate card layout redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a card layout to clearly structure pet registration details and milestone confirmation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "card"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop companion quick start new screen: Insert a new screen before home intro that demonstrates key desktop interaction actions like dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"new_quick_start": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Drag your companion anywhere on screen, or right-click to bring up controls, conversation, and settings.", "layout": "checklist"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_quick_start", "home_intro"]}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-in checklist layout redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a checklist layout that highlights cloud backup, pet recovery, and sync options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "checklist"}}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop environment readiness new flow on waiting screen: Add an environment status verification badge and notification flow to the waiting screen while background rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Desktop Environment Ready", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path spotlight layout redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a spotlight layout focusing on the key choice between premade companions and custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
5: [finish, redesign] Home intro two column layout redesign: Rebuild the final welcome screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet arrival on the left and desktop launch tips on the right.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column"}}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Pet avatar review new screen: Add a dedicated pet visual review screen right after photo upload to verify photo rendering before confirming adoption.
   config: {"new_avatar_review": {"headline": "Review Pet Appearance", "body": "Confirm your pet preview looks correct before generating your final desktop pet model.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_avatar_review", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in multi device recovery hint: Add a prominent helper hint on the sign-in screen explaining that using the same account restores existing pets automatically.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account method to automatically restore saved pets across devices."}}
8: [finish, copy] Home intro desktop control guidance headline update: Update headline and body copy on the final welcome screen to explain how to summon, move, and hide the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to adjust visibility, talk, or open desktop control settings."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen rendering step progress indicator: Enable step counter indicator on the waiting screen to show active rendering progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_step_counter": true}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout inside onboarding is allowed as long as its core function remains.
Adding a new quick start screen before home intro inside onboarding retains all required steps and complies with all base rules.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout inside onboarding is permitted and preserves the sign-in function.
Adding environment readiness indicators and notifications to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under onboarding rules.
Redesigning the choose path screen while maintaining the choice between premade and custom pets satisfies rule requirements.
Redesigning the home intro overlay layout inside onboarding is fully allowed under Rule 4.
Inserting a new avatar review screen after photo upload is a valid addition inside onboarding.
Adding a sign-in helper hint on account recovery within onboarding complies with all rules.
Updating text copy on the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Enabling progress indicators on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.
